{{Quote|This is ''Kestavel''. The place we're checking on is called&hellip; The ''Lucky Twi'lek''. Expensive and elegant, but low key.''"<br />"''Not very inviting. Nearest landing spot is kilometers away, no aerial access possible&mdash;and the only road winds along sheer cliffs over bottomless canyons.|Schurk-Heren and Bomo Greenbark|<ref name="ASR2" />}}
'''Kestavel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], near [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. It was the location of [[The Lucky Twi'lek]]. The crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' [[Ambush at Kestavel|ambushed]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] there in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Kestavel was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
